Its days and counts are added to the topic you pick, and that name is counted there from now on. This can\'t be undone.
Delete every topic, contact and digest Mika has gathered, and the stored notification text? This cannot be undone. Mika will start gathering again from new notifications.
Remove everything gathered from %1$s? Topics only it supported, its contacts, its notification text and the digest lines made from it are all deleted.

Health, finances (debt, income), religion, politics, sexuality, and whether a contact is your partner. Off by default: nothing in these areas is kept. This covers topics and relationships; sentences written by Daily digest are not governed by it.

These are sensitive inferences made from your notifications. Like every topic, they come from sending notification text to the model you confirmed, and they are stored encrypted on this phone. Passwords, codes, card and ID numbers and exact addresses are never kept. That applies to topics, contacts and digest sentences; with Daily digest on, notification text is stored as it is for up to 2 days.
Delete the sensitive topics already stored, or keep them without adding more?

Names come from the notifications themselves, never from the model. A relationship is only a guess unless you set it: it shows after it has come up on at least two days and in most guesses. A contact is established after three days. Deleting a contact also stops Mika from recording that conversation again. People inside a group chat are not tracked one by one. Sentences written by Daily digest may mention who said something in a group.
Contacts %1$d · names %2$d · contact entries kept %3$d, rejected %4$d
Keeps the day\'s notifications so Mika can sum them up. Off by default.
On · %1$d notification texts kept on this phone

To sum up your day, Mika needs to keep what the notifications said. With this on, the title and text of notifications from the apps being distilled are stored on this phone, encrypted, for up to two days, and then deleted. They are sent to the model you confirmed to be summed up. The notes made from them are kept 8 days, and each day\'s digest 35 days. Weekly digests are made from the daily ones and kept 26 weeks; monthly digests are made from the weekly ones and kept 2 years.\n\nTurning this off deletes the stored texts; notes and digests already made stay, and you can delete them under “What Mika has gathered”. Setting an app to “Not read” or “Low” deletes its texts and also the notes and digest lines made from it.
Nothing summed up yet today. Notes appear after a batch of notifications has come in.

A topic counts after 2 days. Up to 10 chats a day per app are flagged. Nothing gathered goes into tasks.
A topic counts after 2 days. Up to 20 chats a day per app are flagged. What is gathered from apps set to High goes into tasks.
A topic counts after 1 day. No limit on flagged chats. What is gathered from apps set to Medium or High goes into tasks.

“Goes into tasks” means each task you start on this phone is given today\'s and yesterday\'s digest and what Mika has noticed about you, marked as coming from notifications and not from you. At no level does Mika speak up unasked or reply for you. What is carried is sent to whichever model runs the task, which may not be the one you confirmed for sorting notifications. A task can also read today\'s and yesterday\'s notification text from those apps when it needs to. When there is room, last week\'s and last month\'s digests are attached too, and a task that needs more can read the stored daily, weekly and monthly digests. A task that was given this is not mined for memories afterwards; what you tell Mika to remember in your own words is still saved.

Only sorted and flagged; no longer gathered from. Its notifications not yet summed up, its stored texts and the digest lines made from it are deleted. Topics and contacts already gathered stay until you clear them under “What Mika has gathered”.
